rawContent: Assembly Hall, UWI, is full for launch of Caribbean Climate-Smart Accelerator #Caribbean #Climate https://t.co/ZWMWTe3hA2
Great job @IDB_Caribbean #JumpCaribbean - Climate resilience, #Climate-smart Cities, Energy Efficiency - Important aspects of #accelerator programme

Now Sir Richard Branson speaks about Caribbean’s vulnerability to #climatechange & plan to lead world with idea of a #Caribbean as climate-smart zone. But 1st he spoke about meeting with Peter Tosh re his song ‘Legalize It’ https://t.co/dtSFNYhcQT

. @the_IDB has been supporting the Caribbean #Climate-smart Accelerator Prog. from idea stage. President of IDB, Luis Alberto Moreno, explains money to be expended & going far together with the #Caribbean https://t.co/utwSTgNorC

Moment of levity, but symbolic, when Sir Richard Branson in T’Shirt went to PM @AndrewHolnessJM at podium & released him from tie & jacket. This was after @EUinJamaica & @peters_lj had already relieved themselves of jackets at #Caribbean #Climate-smart Accelerator Launch https://t.co/Cb2bQTSriL

Risk-matrix that covers 33 countries & territories created. Data in this matrix “demonstrates degree to which future climate stressors (e.g. increased incidence of extreme weather events) are expected to affect the countries” #Caribbean  #ClimateSmart Accelerator #ClimateChange https://t.co/PQ8x1akMHW

The Risk/Matrix allows for “different methods of capturing both overall and sector-specific vulnerabilities to climate stressors.” “..nearly every country in the region is rated..moderate or high vulnerability” #Caribbean #ClimateSmart Accelerator #ClimateChange. https://t.co/LEP3N4P3h8

Glad to have attended. Great Initiative by @richardbranson. #Caribbean countries show strong support for #Climate-Smart Accelerator. Thanks to whichever group included my name on its guest list 👍🏽👍🏽. Like Usain I will help however I can 💪🏽

“The central objective of the Accelerator is to help transform the region’s economy through fast-tracking sound public & private investment(s)..that support climate action & economic growth, through sustainable development” #Caribbean #ClimateSmart #ClimateChange

Dr. Trotz pointed to #ClimateChange as one of the most serious threats to development of the #Caribbean. The CBU Assembly had reps from Cuba (in pic), San Andrés (Colombian island), Belize, Guyana & several Anglophone Caribbean countries. https://t.co/LEP7tAfGQF

Young, female panelist (from Italy) noted that media content re  #climatechange requires journalists to “understand, respond and prepare for disaster”She said “Scientists & Journalists don’t speak the same language & don’t speak to each other.”Suggests “meeting of minds needed”
